answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must stake dynamic collateral verified via zero-knowledge proofs and cryptographic attestation chains. As a Sybil swarm grows from a solitary node like a lone comet into a cluster, validation fees scale superlinearly, creating a cost spiral designed to exhaust adversary reserves. Staking tiers require each identity to cross a validation knoll where exponential capital exhaustion renders large-scale identity spoofing financially unviable.
